title: Hybrid telemetry scorer for region routing with percentile drift detection and network integrity gates
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Implement a hybrid scoring service that combines client-pop and POP-to-POP latency percentiles (p50/p95) with a lightweight network health index to make region selection decisions and trigger fallback to model variants or alternate tiers. Motivation: current region selection relies on single-metric thresholds that either over-trigger fallbacks during transient noise or under-react to correlated network degradation. This ticket introduces: (1) drift detection on p50/p95 windows, (2) a network integrity gate that factors packet-loss and TCP connect failure rates, and (3) a composite score with tunable weights for latency vs network health and hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. The implementation will run as a sidecar scoring service in the region-router pod and expose an HTTP decision endpoint used by the router. We will ship with conservative defaults and provide a console dashboard for score breakdowns and per-route tunables.
acceptance_criteria: Composite score computed every minute per POP and per model-variant using p50 and p95 windows (1m/5m/15m) and normalized network health metric
Drift detector flags p50/p95 regressions with configurable sensitivity and must suppress alerts for single-sample spikes
Router queries scoring endpoint and respects an integrity gate: route only to POPs where network_health >= gate_threshold
Automated functional tests for scoring math and integration test that simulates degraded packet loss and validates fallback to variant-b
Console shows per-POP breakdown (p50, p95, net_health, composite_score) and recent drift annotations
Performance: scoring endpoint must respond < 6ms p95 under light load and scale horizontally with the router layer
Rollout plan with canary (5% traffic) and automatic rollback on error-rate or latency SLO regressions
technical_notes: CompositeScore = w1 * normalized(p50) + w2 * normalized(p95) + w3 * (1 - net_health) where net_health in [0,1]
Normalize percentiles using historical baseline per-POP to account for geographic differences (z-score + clamp)
Drift detection: use EWMA on percentile deltas with a secondary lookback to detect persistent shifts (> 3 consecutive windows)
Network health: synthesize TCP connect failure %, short-lived TLS failures, and 1s-sampled packet loss telemetry into a 0..1 score with decay for older samples
Hysteresis: require composite_score to cross thresholds for two consecutive evaluation windows before triggering a POP eviction; reevaluation window configurable

Fallbacks: mapping table for model variants and routing tiers (e.g., variant-A -> variant-B -> local-fallback). Router must prefer lower-cost variant only if composite_score delta < cost_to_latency_threshold
Rate-limiting: score refresh and router decisions to avoid thundering herd when many POPs flip state; use jittered backoff
Observability: emit scoring_explain events with components and metadata to tracing pipeline; add metric composite_score{pop,model_variant} and drift_alerts counter
Integration: scoring service will read aggregated telemetry from the telemetry aggregator (pull via internal API) and fall back to local short-window estimates if aggregator lag > 10s
Security: scoring endpoint authenticated with mTLS within the cluster; do not expose scoring API externally
